name: CVPR
note: Computer vision; frequently publishes layout, poster, multimodal generation, and evaluation work.

name: ICCV
note: Computer vision; relevant for layout generation, content-aware design, and structured visual generation.

name: ECCV
note: Computer vision; strong coverage of layout, editable design, slide design, and image-generation research.

name: ACM Multimedia
note: Multimedia; recurring venue for layout generation, poster generation, typography, slide generation, and multimodal design systems.

name: CIKM
note: Information and knowledge management; has published industrial poster-layout and content-aware design work.

name: NeurIPS
note: Machine learning; relevant for generative modeling, multimodal agents, evaluation, and scientific-poster automation.

name: ICLR
note: Machine learning; relevant for generative models, language-based layout generation, scientific-poster agents, and evaluation.

name: ICML
note: Machine learning; relevant for generative modeling and controllable structured generation.

name: AAAI
note: Artificial intelligence; includes structured and controllable layout-generation research.

name: IJCAI
note: Artificial intelligence; includes content-aware advertising and poster-layout generation.

name: ACL
note: Natural language processing; increasingly relevant to paper-to-poster and document-to-design agent systems.

name: CHI
note: Human-computer interaction; relevant for interactive and human-centered graphic-design systems.

name: ICASSP
note: Signal processing and multimedia; includes poster and text-layout generation work.

name: ICME
note: Multimedia; relevant for multimodal content generation and visual-design systems.

name: SIGGRAPH
note: Computer graphics and interactive techniques; important for content-aware design and visual composition.

name: SIGGRAPH Asia
note: Computer graphics and interactive techniques; relevant for graphic-design generation and evaluation.

name: BMVC
note: Computer vision; includes scientific-poster layout datasets and document-layout research.

name: ACM Transactions on Graphics
note: Graphics journal associated with SIGGRAPH research in visual synthesis and design.

name: IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics
note: Visualization and graphics journal with foundational work on learned graphic layouts.

name: IEEE Transactions on Multimedia
note: Multimedia journal covering visual composition, poster layout, and multimodal generation.

name: Pattern Recognition
note: Pattern-recognition journal publishing scientific-poster and controllable poster-layout generation research.

name: The Visual Computer
note: Graphics and visual-computing journal with work on layout and graphic-design generation.

name: Information Fusion
note: Information-fusion journal including surveys and multimodal generative methods.

name: WACV
note: Computer vision; includes graphic-design evaluation and multimodal visual-generation work.

name: Pacific Graphics
note: Computer graphics; includes optimization, authoring, and graphic-layout research.

name: Graphic Design Understanding and Generation (GDUG)
note: Dedicated graphic-design workshop series; held at CVPR 2024 and ICCV 2025 with topics spanning layout, typography, datasets, evaluation, and AI-assisted authoring.

name: Human-Interactive Generation and Editing (HiGen)
note: Human-interactive visual generation and editing workshop; first held at ICCV 2025 and second at CVPR 2026, including multimodal control and sketch-guided design generation.

name: AI for Content Creation (AI4CC)
note: Recurring CVPR workshop on AI-assisted content creation across art, design, documents, advertising, photography, video, and related media.

name: AI for Creative Visual Content Generation, Editing and Understanding (CVEU)
note: Workshop series on generative and editing technologies for creative visual content, with editions across CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, and SIGGRAPH-related venues.
